name: app-research-slide-black-with-neon-stats-and-insight-cards
title: Black user-research slide with neon lime stats and three dark insight cards
whatItIs: A black slide with outlined pills User Research and Key Insights, a big headline 'What do users actually want?', three lime statistics with small captions at left, three dark cards at right numbered 01-03 with tags, a methods row and a lime bar stating the core insight.
whatItMeans: Sharp and evidence-led; lime numerals draw the eye to the proof.
techniques: Use lime numerals for statistics against black.
Stack insight cards with a number, bold statement, and grey explanation.
Tag each card with a small grey pill.
End with a lime bar summarising the key insight.

vocabulary.definition: A large statistic in a bright colour.
A highlighted strip stating the main takeaway.
